description: This Kotlin source file defines a JUnit test rule called MainDispatcherRule which manages the main coroutine dispatcher during tests by setting it to a specified TestDispatcher (defaulting to UnconfinedTestDispatcher) and resetting it afterward.

classes.name: MainDispatcherRule
classes.description: A JUnit TestRule that sets the main coroutine dispatcher to a specified TestDispatcher during test execution and resets it afterward.

methods.name: starting
methods.description: Overrides the starting method of TestWatcher to set the main dispatcher to the testDispatcher before the test begins.

methods.name: finished
methods.description: Overrides the finished method of TestWatcher to reset the main dispatcher after the test completes.
